clue.text: What Oporto vintagers do and their shippers hope to do

definitions.meaning: wine producers in Oporto produce the fortified wine named after the city
a ship's crew hopes to reach harbour safely

explanation.surface: A note on the wine trade of Oporto, from the vineyard to the cargo ships.
explanation.walkthrough: The same two words read two ways: producing the wine, and a ship arriving at a harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Vintners there produce the fortified wine; a vessel that reaches harbour has arrived safely, so both phrases fit.

clue.text: Maybe a yen to become all powerful

parts.note: 'it might happen' means maybe it will, so might stands for maybe
Y is the abbreviation for the Japanese currency, the yen

explanation.surface: A small longing grows into a craving for total power.
explanation.definitionFit: Something with enormous strength or force is described as all powerful; a synonym.

clue.text: Nothing in a kiln apart from what may be fired in it

definitions.text: what may be fired in it

indicators.note: the first in tells us the zero goes inside the rearranged letters
pulled apart, the letters of the two words are broken up and rearranged

parts.note: nothing is zero, which looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: An empty kiln with nothing inside except the clay waiting to be baked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'apart' scrambles A KILN to KALIN; 'in' puts O inside it after the A.
explanation.definitionFit: This fine white china clay is the material potters bake into porcelain.

clue.text: Modelled a question

definitions.meaning: an artist's model sat or stood for a portrait
to put forward a question is to raise it

explanation.surface: An artist's sitter is asked something.
explanation.definitionFit: Sitting for an artist means holding an attitude for them; raising a query is also said this way.

clue.text: Brazilian city needs diplomacy for the control of civil disorder

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is Brazil's best-known city
tact is diplomacy, skill in handling people

explanation.surface: A Brazilian city's leaders need tact when handling street unrest.
explanation.walkthrough: The Riot Act was an 18th-century British law read out to order a crowd to disperse; reading it is the classic image of quelling unrest.
explanation.definitionFit: The old statute was a legal instrument for dispersing riotous crowds.

clue.text: Temporary freedom from gaol that is given by the magistrate

parts.note: bail is release from custody pending trial
i.e. is the abbreviation of Latin id est, that is

explanation.surface: A judge grants an accused person bail.
explanation.walkthrough: A BAILIE is a Scottish municipal magistrate.
explanation.definitionFit: In Scotland a town councillor serving as a judge in minor cases holds this title.

clue.text: Nevertheless there's no speed restriction

definitions.meaning: used to mean in any case, whatever happens
read literally, travel at whatever pace you like

explanation.surface: A grudging remark that the road has no speed limit.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means in any case; taken literally it says any pace is allowed.

clue.text: Agricultural recruits sue cessfully conduct seaborne invasion

definitions.meaning: the Women's ... sent women to work on farms in both World Wars
troops coming ashore from ships successfully put soldiers on the beach

explanation.surface: Farm volunteers are pictured as an invading force coming ashore.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sue cessfully' is a misprint of 'successfully'. The Women's Land Army recruited British women to farm work during the World Wars.
explanation.definitionFit: The wartime farm workforce had this name; troops disembarking from ships also put soldiers on shore.

clue.text: One who explains the power of maths

definitions.meaning: someone who expounds or interprets a theory
the index written above a number showing how many times it is multiplied by itself

explanation.surface: A teacher explaining what makes mathematics so powerful.
explanation.definitionFit: An advocate who sets out ideas has this name; in algebra it is the raised index of a power.

clue.text: Excellent entertainment which is well done!

definitions.meaning: a fine performance or display
an old-fashioned British exclamation of praise

explanation.surface: Applause for a fine performance.
explanation.definitionFit: A splendid performance is a fine one; the phrase is also a dated cry of congratulation.

clue.text: Little sleep for Kitty on the carpet

parts.note: kitty is a pet name for a cat
nap is the raised pile on a carpet's surface

explanation.surface: A pet cat dozing on the rug.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's picture of a cat curled up on the rug is also the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A short doze during the day is a brief rest.

clue.text: Network issues call for silence to the Levant

indicators.note: to signals that the hushing sound is added to the regional abbreviation

parts.note: the Levant lies in the region known as the Middle East, ME
sh is the hushing sound that asks for quiet

explanation.surface: Broadcasting network problems: a request for quiet heading east.
explanation.definitionFit: A net is an interlaced structure of threads; a synonym.

clue.text: Very poor would be hit by addition to property and water charges

definitions.meaning: of the lowest quality

definitions.text: would be hit by addition to property and water charges
definitions.meaning: a further local charge on top of two existing rates would be one more levy

explanation.surface: Poor households would suffer if another levy were added to their bills.
explanation.walkthrough: Rates were British local property taxes; water rates were billed separately, so a new charge would be the next in line.
explanation.definitionFit: Something shoddy is inferior quality; literally a further levy after two others.

clue.text: Long period of time to reach the Pole

parts.note: a year is a period of time
N stands for the North Pole

explanation.surface: An Arctic expedition takes a long time to reach its goal.
explanation.definitionFit: To long for something is to pine or crave it; the verb sense.

clue.text: The sound of a gun from a mountain pass

indicators.note: the sound of tells us to say a word and spell it differently

parts.note: gat is old American slang for a pistol

explanation.surface: A gunshot echoes down from a mountain pass.
explanation.walkthrough: In India a ghat is a mountain pass, or steps down to a river.
explanation.definitionFit: In Indian English this word names a pass through hills or mountains.

clue.text: Mounts an agricultural tool over the door for luck

parts.note: riders' mounts are horses
a hoe is a garden or farm tool for weeding

explanation.surface: Farm life: horses and tools, and a good-luck charm above the stable door.
explanation.definitionFit: A curved iron plate from a hoof is traditionally hung above doorways as a charm.

clue.text: Chief executioner

definitions.meaning: a tribal leader or village head
the one who beheads the condemned

explanation.surface: The man in charge of public executions.
explanation.definitionFit: A village leader bears this title; it is also one who cuts off heads with an axe.

clue.text: Unused garden plot for occasional guests

definitions.meaning: a flowerbed left empty
an extra place to sleep for visitors

explanation.surface: A garden patch kept free for visitors.
explanation.definitionFit: An empty flowerbed is surplus ground; a guest room's extra place to sleep is the same phrase.

clue.text: A pressing personal request for ferrous material?

definitions.meaning: a plea to someone to press one's own clothes
an excavation from which metal ore is dug

explanation.surface: An urgent appeal about something made of metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Asking someone to press your clothing could be phrased this way; it is also a pit producing ore.

clue.text: Depict gleam of light coming from left side of the ship

parts.note: port is the left side of a vessel facing forward
a ray is a beam or gleam of light

explanation.surface: A painter catches a beam of light on the side of a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: To represent in art or words is to depict; a synonym.

clue.text: Only Alexandria contains a famous university

indicators.note: contains shows that the letters sit within the two words given

explanation.surface: Only one Egyptian city has a renowned seat of learning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Alexandria' suggests its ancient library, but the letters straddle the two words.
explanation.definitionFit: This Ivy League institution in Connecticut is world-renowned.

clue.text: Maybe one who manages to draw a knot tight

definitions.text: Maybe one who manages to draw a knot tight

parts.words: Maybe one who manages to draw a knot tight
parts.note: one who fastens a knot, or one who manages a drawn match, is a person who does that action

explanation.surface: A sailor pulling a knot firmly closed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'draw' hints at a level score as well as pulling a rope taut.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who fastens string, or levels a contest, is a doer of that verb.

clue.text: Excessively virtuous, but can it be true?

definitions.meaning: overly well-behaved
recalls the idiom said of something suspiciously perfect

explanation.surface: A doubtful response to someone who seems a saint.
explanation.definitionFit: Overly righteous people seem implausibly perfect, which is the idiom's suspicion.

clue.text: Fixing up ailment with a copper band

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
a ring is a band, such as one worn on a finger

explanation.surface: A copper bracelet as a folk remedy for illness.
explanation.walkthrough: Copper bangles are a traditional folk cure for arthritis, so the surface is apt.
explanation.definitionFit: Healing a disease means making the patient better.

clue.text: Refer to classified columns if you want to see one

definitions.meaning: to ... to something is to mention it

definitions.text: classified columns if you want to see one
definitions.meaning: the small-ads pages are where notices for sale are found

explanation.surface: Advice to check the small-ads pages.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it is a formal word for mention; as a noun it is a notice in the small ads.

clue.text: Roam the mountains?

definitions.meaning: to wander freely
a chain of peaks

explanation.surface: Wandering through the hills.
explanation.definitionFit: To wander over a wide area; also a line of peaks such as the Rockies.

clue.text: Survey applied to those who appear obese

definitions.meaning: take a glance about

definitions.text: applied to those who appear obese
definitions.meaning: a description of people who seem plump

explanation.surface: A survey of overweight people.
explanation.definitionFit: To glance about is to survey; the words also describe a person whose appearance is plump.

clue.text: They wind up Scottish dances

definitions.meaning: spools on which line or film is wound
lively Highland dances

explanation.surface: Lively Scottish dances bring an evening to an end.
explanation.definitionFit: Spools take up fishing line or film; lively Highland dances share the name.

clue.text: Clever opponent of the Corn Laws

definitions.meaning: intelligent, quick-witted
John ..., Victorian MP and leader of the Anti-Corn Law League

explanation.surface: A shrewd campaigner against Britain's grain tariffs.
explanation.walkthrough: The Corn Laws were British tariffs on imported grain, repealed in 1846 after a campaign led by Cobden and Bright.
explanation.definitionFit: Intelligent is a synonym; John Bright was the Victorian MP who fought the grain tariffs.

clue.text: Romantic involvement is needed to enjoy one's very existence

definitions.meaning: one's relationships and affairs of the heart
relish being alive

explanation.surface: Romance is what makes living worthwhile.
explanation.definitionFit: One's romantic relationships taken together; read as a verb phrase it means relish being alive.

clue.text: Reckoned an English river leads to small sea

parts.note: the Dee flows through Chester on the English-Welsh border, and it leads, coming first
Med is the short form of the Mediterranean Sea, the sea the river runs to

explanation.surface: A river is thought to flow into a small sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Judged or considered to be; a synonym.

clue.text: Unusual spectacle calling for corrective spectacles

definitions.meaning: a strange thing to see
eyesight that is uneven or faulty

explanation.surface: A strange scene that makes one reach for glasses.
explanation.definitionFit: A strange view is a peculiar scene; uneven vision needing glasses is read the same way.
